observed_architecture: CognitiveEnvelope already accepts explicit generation-bound SignalReadout values, evaluates configured bands, fails required missing evidence to UNKNOWN, and emits an immutable ControlSnapshot only.
AdaptiveCompute already maps ControlSnapshot dispositions WITHIN/DEGRADED/HARD_LIMIT/UNKNOWN to bounded GRID work ceilings.

PerceptionComputeBinding explicitly states that Perception must not create an independent resource governor and derives PerceptionWorkerPolicy from the exact ControlSnapshot plus exact AdaptiveCompute allocation.

WP710 currently defines a second PerceptionSchedulerPolicy containing max_active_workers and max_perception_work_units and additionally derives pressure_degraded from available_compute_units <= control_reserve_units.
architecture_problem: Adding a direct PSI ResourcePressureSnapshot input plus independent pressure thresholds to WP710 would duplicate the existing CognitiveEnvelope resource-governance path and create two potentially divergent authorities for perception compute ceilings.

signal_ingress: A host adapter outside pure cognition/scheduler code reads Linux PSI when supported.

Emit ordinary CognitiveEnvelope SignalReadout values with exact generation, evidence_refs and provenance_refs, e.g. bounded integer stall-pressure measures for cpu.some, memory.some/full and io.some/full. Exact metric set and policy thresholds remain to be calibrated; they are not established by this E2 result.
Prefer a dedicated F2/perception cgroup scope when available; system-wide PSI is lower-specificity evidence because unrelated host workloads contribute.
best_supported_delta.control_path: PSI host adapter -> CognitiveEnvelope SignalReadout -> ControlSnapshot -> AdaptiveCompute allocation -> PerceptionComputeBinding -> PerceptionWorkerPolicy -> WP710 queue/dispatch planner
wp710_policy_repair: Do not allow WP710 to independently expand worker/work ceilings beyond PerceptionWorkerPolicy.

Prefer splitting scheduler-only queue semantics (max_queue_items, coalescing/drop policy, pressure_drop_below_priority_micros) from compute ceilings, or deterministically clamping any retained scheduler ceilings by the exact PerceptionWorkerPolicy.
Bind the exact PerceptionWorkerPolicy digest/generation into the schedule plan provenance so stale or mismatched resource authority fails closed.
brownout_semantics: Use existing CognitiveEnvelope dispositions as the primary degradation state rather than inventing a second pressure-level enum.
DEGRADED may shed low-value optional perception; HARD_LIMIT and UNKNOWN must be no less conservative than DEGRADED, consistent with existing PerceptionComputeBinding invariants.
Never consume or reduce the caller-declared cognition/control reserve to preserve perception work.
best_supported_delta.telemetry_failure: Missing/stale PSI evidence must remain explicit UNKNOWN if configured required; if PSI is optional/unsupported, the existing non-PSI envelope signals and compute-reserve path continue without fabricating a healthy PSI reading.
best_supported_delta.effects_boundary: Reading PSI is measurement ingress only. cgroup quota/memory.high writes are resource-control effects outside WP710 and receive no authority from this delta.

expected_benefits: Uses experienced stall pressure rather than raw utilization as an additional overload discriminator.
Preserves one deterministic resource-governance authority chain instead of duplicating it inside Perception.
Reuses existing UNKNOWN/degraded/hard-limit fail-closed semantics and exact provenance machinery.
Requires only a thin host adapter plus policy/readout wiring; no external runtime framework import is justified.
costs_and_risks: PSI is Linux-specific and host/system scope can couple unrelated workload pressure into F2 decisions.
Thresholds can oscillate; calibration/hysteresis must be validated before runtime promotion.
PSI stall evidence may be redundant with existing CognitiveEnvelope signals and caller compute availability.
Additional readouts increase policy/configuration complexity and can cause conservative UNKNOWN states if marked required on unsupported hosts.
counterhypothesis: Existing CognitiveEnvelope inputs plus available_compute_units/control_reserve_units already protect cognition/control adequately; PSI yields no measurable improvement in missed-deadline, queue-age, control-reserve or quality metrics and should therefore not be added.

falsifier.next_stage: E4_F2_ABLATION after a bounded E3 source/contract fixture if needed
falsifier.compare: same deterministic synthetic pressure/recovery workload with PSI-derived envelope signals disabled versus enabled
must_measure: perception queue age and drop/coalescing counts
task/perception quality proxy under equivalent workload
falsifier.reject_delta_if: PSI path does not improve overload discrimination or graceful degradation enough to justify complexity, or causes stale/noisy host pressure to suppress valuable perception without protecting control/cognition.

next_exact_action: Validate the proposed one-governor bridge contract against the latest WP710 scheduler integration and create a deterministic source-level regression/ablation design; no Trigger4 E5 handoff until measured benefit exists.
